digest.component_or_area: LLM provider framework - OpenAI target resolution
propositions: pydantic-ai 1.107.2 emits PydanticAIDeprecationWarning when infer_model receives ambiguous openai: prefix because v2 will reinterpret it as Responses instead of Chat Completions
rebar's _pai_model and model_classes._resolve_target generate or preserve ambiguous openai: targets instead of explicit openai-chat: qualifiers
ProviderSession custom-endpoint builder registration and per-candidate endpoint override gates recognize only the legacy openai provider name, not the explicit openai-chat qualifier
normalizing all inferred, configured, and legacy-explicit OpenAI targets to openai-chat: preserves existing Chat Completions wire semantics while resolving the v2 deprecation warning
ProviderSession must accept openai-chat: as a provider-name key to maintain custom base_url and per-candidate endpoint routing after target normalization
